idea-plugin.name: WP Template Coder: MCP Support
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.8

  • 优化插件图标：将 pluginIcon.svg 周边黑色边框改为透明，提升商店显示效果
  • 修复兼容性问题：解决低版本 IDE 下文件导出功能无反应的问题（Java 8 兼容性修复）
  • 优化导出流程：统一实时模板与文件模板的导出保存逻辑

1.1.7

  • 优化模板列表加载逻辑：在已有数据时进行静默刷新，消除界面闪烁感
  • 修复在提示“使用默认开放服务器”时，来回切换 Tab 导致点击链接打开多个网页的 Bug
  • 优化 UI 状态维护，确保加载过程中界面显示更平滑
  • 改进异常处理，确保在网络错误时能正确显示提示信息
  • Fixed network request issue in EDT thread for IntelliJ Platform 243.* compatibility
  • All network requests now execute in background threads to prevent UI blocking
  • Added asynchronous template loading with proper thread management
  • Improved error handling and user feedback during template loading
  • Enhanced stability on older IntelliJ Platform versions

1.1.6

  • Integrated Local MCP (Model Context Protocol) service for AI assistance
  • Exposed tools: list_file_templates, get_file_template, list_live_templates, get_live_template
  • Added MCP toggle and port configuration in settings
  • Added easy configuration copy for AI tools like Cursor and Claude
  • Enhanced template metadata (descriptions, extensions) for better AI judgment
  • Added automatic MCP server recovery on IDE startup
  • Improved port conflict handling for multiple IDE windows

1.1.5

  • Extended version compatibility to support IntelliJ Platform 243 and above
  • Added support for IC-243.24978.46 and later versions
  • Removed upper version limit for better future compatibility
  • Removed unnecessary dependencies (Android, Kotlin, Java plugins) for better compatibility
  • Plugin now works with all IntelliJ Platform IDEs, including HarmonyOS DevEco Studio
  • Reduced plugin size and improved loading performance

1.1.2

  • Added selective export feature for templates
  • Added quick share after export feature
  • Improved template server stability
  • Added Git version control for template storage
  • Fixed template list sorting by creation time
  • Improved error messages and user feedback

1.1.0

  • Added template sharing feature with remote server
  • Added role-based access control for template sharing
  • Added template deletion with admin permission
  • Improved UI with better organized toolbar
  • Added server configuration dialog

1.0.2

  • Initial release
  • Support import/export file templates
  • Support import/export live templates
  • Add tool window for quick access
idea-plugin.description:
Template management plugin for IntelliJ Platform IDEs with sharing capabilities and AI integration.
由微派会玩开发一款代码模版插件工具，支持文件模版和代码模版的管理，统一项目代码规范与风格，提升效率，以及MCP服务的提供，协助AI写出更规范的代码

Features:
  • Local Template Management
    • Quick access to template settings
    • Import/Export templates to/from files
    • Support both File Templates and Live Templates
    • Selective export with template preview
    • Quick share after successful export
  • Template Sharing
    • Share templates with team members via remote server
    • Role-based access control (Admin/Writer/Reader)
    • Easy-to-use server configuration
    • Git version control for template history
    • Sorted template list by creation time
  • AI Integration (MCP Support)
    • Local MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for AI assistance
    • AI can query file templates and live templates to maintain code style consistency
    • Easy configuration for Cursor, Claude Desktop, and other MCP-compatible AI tools
    • Automatic server recovery on IDE startup
    • Enhanced template metadata for better AI judgment
  • User Interface
    • Intuitive tool window with organized toolbar
    • Separate tabs for File Templates and Live Templates
    • Clear visual feedback for all operations
    • Improved error messages and user guidance
    • Asynchronous template loading for better performance
    • Silent refresh to reduce flickering
    • Loading status indicators and improved error messages
  • Compatibility & Performance
    • Full support for IntelliJ Platform 243 and above
    • Thread-safe network operations (fixed EDT thread issues)
    • Compatible with all IntelliJ Platform IDEs (IntelliJ IDEA, Android Studio, PyCharm, WebStorm, CLion, etc.)
    • Optimized for older IntelliJ Platform versions
    • No unnecessary dependencies - lightweight and fast

Usage:
  • Open the WP Coder tool window (View > Tool Windows > WP Coder)
  • Switch between File Templates and Live Templates using tabs
  • Use toolbar buttons for various operations:
    • Export/Import templates to/from files
    • Share/Get templates from server
    • Configure server settings (requires API key)
  • Enable MCP server in settings to allow AI tools to access your templates

Server Access Levels:
  • Admin: Full access (upload, download, delete)
  • Writer: Can upload and download templates
  • Reader: Can only download templates

AI Integration:
  • Enable MCP server in plugin settings
  • Copy the provided configuration to your AI tool's MCP config file
  • AI can now query your templates to maintain consistent code style
  • Supports Cursor, Claude Desktop, and other MCP-compatible tools
